name: artemis-app-showcase
title: App showcase
description: A phone floating on a mesh-gradient shader stage, flanked by four features. Photo-rich screens slide in from the direction of travel and play their own detail motion, teammate activity pops beside the device, and the phone tilts toward the pointer. Auto-advance pauses on hover, focus, and when off screen
